decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The position and design of the outbuilding is such that there would be no harm to adjacent residents or the appearance of the street scene.  The propsal therefore complies with policies ENVB 1.1 (All New Development) and H 6.4(Extensions and Alterations) of the Unitary Development Plan.
Condition : 2 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any wall of the outbuilding hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall only be used as a store room, gym or play room and shall not be used as a separate residential unit.  No other facilities such as a bathroom or kitchen shall be installed uses such as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or other.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Erection of single storey store/playroom in rear garden to house.
